items.text: Victor P. Henderson is an attorney and a former certified public accountant who serves on the board of Urban Prep Academies. He is a former president of the Chicago Bar Association. His campaign focuses on fiscal responsibility, and he has said he would commission a forensic audit. His campaign website states that decisions made to advance political agendas rather than student achievement have no place in the schools. He has emphasized local control and accountability, saying the school system should be focused on children and run by taxpayers.
